model.load_coupling: the interference term of TRxP t is multiplied by its realized occupancy (DL: its PDSCH load on that carrier; UL: the PUSCH load of its cell, applied to its E1c.2 scheduled interferer at target power); mean interference (not Bernoulli); 3.5 GHz and 7.2 GHz, DL and UL are four independent fixed points (synchronized TDD, separate carriers)
model.fixed_point: L = min(1, f(L)), f_k = T sum_{u in cell k} w_u / (cap SE_load(gamma_u(L))); plain iteration from L = 1 (monotone decrease to the maximal fixed point) until max |dL| <= 1e-10, at most 20000 iterations; offered load rho_k = f_k(L)
model.flow_level: flow throughput theta_u = C_u (1 - L_k) if rho_k < 1, else 0 (unstable); served traffic d_u min(1, 1/rho_k), unserved d_u max(0, 1 - 1/rho_k)
model.peak_rate: C = SE(gamma) x N_PRB x 12 x 30 kHz x TDD share x (1 - OH); SE = C-AMC T2 (E1.5.3a), bits per Hz per second of occupied data resources (DMRS and HARQ losses included; PDCCH, guard and TDD not)

tdd.rule: tau_dl = 52/70, tau_ul = 16/70 symbols of the 5-slot period; same pattern on both carriers

overhead_ts38306.note: FR1 values used at both carriers (7.2 GHz lies above FR1's 7.125 GHz edge; TS 38.306 defines no FR3 value). The C-AMC SE already contains DMRS, so OH partly double-counts it (conservative). Its effects are analytic: theta / R scales by (1 - OH); the UL/DL load ratio by (1 - OH_DL)/(1 - OH_UL) = 0.935

model.admission: a user is admitted on a carrier and direction iff its full-buffer SE (every ON TRxP of that carrier at weight 1) >= SE_adm, the C-AMC value at the curve's first grid point above snr_min (the 5G-LENA MCS-0 plateau; DL 0.1969 at -0.64 dB, UL 0.1965 at -0.64 dB). Between snr_min and that point the DL curve is the 5G-LENA MCS-0 BLER floor (hazard 15), where a time-fair model would charge up to 120x the resources per bit. Users admitted on no carrier are 'not admitted' (D8 unservable): their traffic is reported separately and they are excluded from the QoS criterion. Reported per direction: the not-admitted share, the share between snr_min and the admission point, and the share in TR 36.942's low end (-10 dB to snr_min)

association.dl_on: 7.2 GHz iff the own 7.2 GHz cell is on (D13), admitted there and its full-buffer peak rate >= the 3.5 GHz one; else 3.5 GHz if admitted
association.ul_on_ulca: UL carrier aggregation: the DL rule applied to the UL (F2 full-band SINR, victim at 23 dBm)
association.ul_on_scell_dl: DL-only SCell: UL stays on 3.5 GHz (identical to ul_off by construction; gate B7b)
association.static: association is fixed per state at full-buffer SINR (standard in load coupling); it does not follow the load

model.ul_access: primary: full-band time-fair sharing (F2 SINR), as Phase 2's primary profile and the E1.5.4 packet-level F2 check
model.ul_rescue_sensitivity: case C, both ISDs: a power-limited UL user below the admission SNR transmits on a fluid PRB share n/N = 10^((gamma - gamma_adm)/10) at gamma_adm (admitted iff n >= 1 PRB at full buffer); rate C_full x SE_adm x n/N, load per bit 1/(cap SE_adm). States off_rescue and on_ulca_rescue

qos.required_rate: R_x = SE5_x x W_op(3.5 GHz) x tau_x (M.2410 sec. 4.4 effective bandwidth); W_op = the 3.5 GHz channel bandwidth of the case (C: 100 MHz, A/B: 20 MHz); the same absolute target on either carrier
qos.outage: user u is in outage in direction x iff theta_u < R_x; pooled admitted-user outage = sum over realizations and admitted users of w_u [outage] / sum of w_u; QoS criterion: pooled admitted-user outage <= epsilon (the 5th-percentile requirement); the all-user outage (not admitted counted as outage) is also reported

decision: the P3.2b layer (solver, ETSI calibration, association, admission and QoS rules) is the traffic layer of P3.2c and P3.3; P3.2c's growth sweep spans g = 1 to at least the all-on UL-CA x*_both of the primary point, marking the 3.5-GHz-only x*_both
